title: Weekly reminder to count your shelf
summary: Once a week, remind the owner to count what is on the shelf, so missing stock is found early.
description: On the day and at the time you choose, reminds the owner to count the shelf: send *count* on WhatsApp and Taskiem asks item by item, or use Count the shelf on the Stock page. Each difference is kept with its reason, and what went missing is valued at what you paid.

params.name: count_day
params.title: Day
params.description: The day of the week: 1 is Monday, 6 Saturday, 0 Sunday.

params.name: count_time
params.title: Time
params.description: When the reminder is sent, Lagos time.

steps.name: Read how many items you keep

input.message: ='Time to count your shelf: ' + string(steps.items.output.count) + ' items. Send count on WhatsApp and Taskiem asks you item by item, or use Count the shelf on the Stock page.'
